desc: Read input using fast I/O and parse integers.
Store queries as tuples `(R, X, original_index)` and sort them by `R`.
Initialize an empty list `tails` to maintain the LIS structure and an array `answers` of size $Q$.
Iterate through $A$ from index 0 to $N-1$ and update `tails` with $A[i]$ using `bisect_left`.
Process all queries with $R = i+1$ using `bisect_right` on `tails` with $X$, store result in `answers`.
Print all answers in the original order.
